title: [DECISION] ECDH Z never leaves provider via HKDF embedding
description: wolfssl_ecdh_agree performs ECDH(A_priv, B_pub) to produce Z, immediately feeds Z into wc_HKDF, then memzero_explicit(z) before any exit. Z is a stack variable; it never appears in any UAPI struct, log message, or return value. This satisfies SP 800-56A requirement that raw shared secret not be exposed to callers and FIPS 140-3 zeroization. The design choice to embed HKDF in the agree callback (rather than returning Z for the caller to KDF separately) is correct and should not be changed.
